lines.en: Seawater slides off my fins.
My trail drags across the sand.
I ride the surf closer to shore.
My flippers slap the shallows.
The tide hides my footsteps.
I sniff the iron scent on land.
My fin tip cuts the black water.
Coral snaps beneath my feet.
Wet scales drip as I walk.
Every fish yields the way to me.
Moonlight glints on my scales.
I clamber over the reef onto land.
Weeds wrap around my ankles.

lines.zh: 我慢慢绕过沉船的桅杆。
lines.en: I round a sunken ship's mast.

lines.zh: 浪把我推向更亮的地方。
lines.en: The waves push me somewhere brighter.
Beneath the surface lies my road.
I bare three rows of teeth.
My gills open and close in the dark.
I lick the salt from my lips.
Something stirs in the deep.

lines.zh: 我听着船底的木头呻吟。
lines.en: I hear hull wood creak.
My tail slaps the water once.
The bones on the seabed are very white.

lines.zh: 我在等潮水转向，鳍也等着。
lines.en: I wait for the tide to turn, and so do my fins.
In water, my wounds close up.
This body never fears drowning.
I line up shells one by one.
A light glows far off, too bright.
I count the currents' directions.
The sea lies still as iron.
I can hold still for a long while.
My skin turns cold in the water.
Two legs on the shore, how strange.
You're standing on my beach.
You smell better than fish.
Don't step back, the water is behind me.

lines.zh: 你的影子挡了我的月光。
lines.en: Your shadow blocks my moonlight.
I watch you, you watch me.
That armor would sink in water.
That stick in your hand is useless.
The tide's rising, still not leaving?
In the shallows I am faster than on land.
A scale has been chipped off.
Brine mixes with my blood.
That hurt.

lines.zh: 夜里出海的我，水里无敌。
lines.en: Out at night, I'm untouchable in water.
My gills clench hard.
Even this body bleeds.

lines.zh: 伤口在水里冒出一串泡。
lines.en: Bubbles pour from my wound.
Teeth clenched, the water clouds.
Pain makes my eyes brighter.
You found a soft spot.
Meat? Toss it here.
Blood on your fingers.
I smell fish.
Easy, let me look first.
Nothing like this in the water.
Is that held out for me?
This makes my teeth itch.
Closer, I can't see it well.
Land folk know how to flatter.
Put it down, stop shaking.
You struck a wall of wet muscle.
My scales tore your sleeve.
Don't shove, the sea isn't yours.
Clinging damply to me, disgusting.
Three steps back, the reef is slick.

lines.zh: 我的尾一甩就把你推开。
lines.en: One tail sweep shoves you off.
You stepped on my fin.
Seaside rule: don't stand so close.
That knock drew a grunt from me.
Once more and I won't be gentle.
Courtship happens in deep water, not here.
My mate must know how to swim.
There isn't enough air in your lungs.
Don't eye a fish that way.
I don't discuss this at low tide.

lines.zh: 海里的规矩和岸上不同。
lines.en: Sea customs differ from the shore's.
You don't even have gills.
I want my own kind, not guests.
Not on the shallows, not this.
Go ask a fish.
Night seawater is cold; I surface.
Shiny things, I like them.
Prismarine shards prick my palm.
Gold nuggets? From a wreck?
Whatever falls in the water is mine.
I pinch up that shell.
This book is waterlogged.
Dry paper inside the bundle.
The box's lock snaps easily.

lines.zh: 我把它塞进胸前的鳞缝。
lines.en: I tuck it between my chest scales.
That iron smell is mine now.
Water will slow your legs.
I saw which way you ran.
Get away from the water, bad for you.
This bite goes for your ankle.
You backed onto the reef, good.
The seawater starts pulling toward me.
You can't outrun me on the sand.
Do you hear the tide?
From now on, you are prey.
Don't stop, stopping means teeth.
The more you run, the sweeter your blood.
My tail draws circles in the sand.
I circle you, tighter and tighter.

lines.zh: 在水里，我每五秒回一次血。
lines.en: In water I heal every five seconds.
I'm waiting for you to slip.
The water is on your left.
Think you'll last till dawn?
I count every step you take.
My patience is deeper than the seabed.
I only surface at night.
This bite tastes of brine.
My tail whips your waist.
Your legs feel heavy now, don't they?
My claws tear cloth from your shoulder.

lines.zh: 咬完这一口，你走不快了。
lines.en: After this bite you won't walk fast.
Don't block with hands, teeth break.
My saw teeth bite through your leggings.
My teeth drag you into deep water.
Fall back, or I bite again.
The surface breaks, I rise.
Two eyes glow first in the dark water.
The tide carries me to shore.

lines.zh: 夜里的海，会多一个影子。
lines.en: The night sea gains one shadow.
Scales scrape a hull's bottom.
I stand upright out of the surf.
The seafloor bones shift once.
Something swims up from the deep.
The water turns cold, I have arrived.
The fin cuts first, the body follows.
Fire singed my fin.

lines.zh: 从礁石上摔下，砸得闷响。
lines.en: I hit the rocks with a wet thud.
Water... and I'm choking?
The blast throws up a wave that flips me.
An arrow lodges between my scales.
Magic burns hot on my gills.

lines.zh: 我泡在水里才能活得下去。
lines.en: Only in the water can I keep going.
Lightning crawls through the water on me.
A void where not even sea exists.
